citation.authors: Liu X, Machado GC, Eyles JP, Ravi V, Hunter DJ

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: People with hand, hip or knee osteoarthritis in 69 randomised trials of 20 dietary supplements
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis with GRADE rating
record.finding: Collagen hydrolysate was one of 7 supplements with large short-term pain effects. No supplement had clinically important effects on pain at long term, and evidence quality was rated very low to high, very low overall.
record.note: Collagen is one of 20 supplements here. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
